scenes.vo: A patient asks for a check-up this week. Seen.
Meanwhile, another clinic replies in three minutes. Thursday, four p.m. Booked.
[flat] The first clinic? Nothing. All day.
[deadpan] Next morning: "So sorry for the delay! Still looking for an appointment?"
Maybe nobody ignored it. Maybe the front desk was with a patient.
[quiet] An instant first reply, then a person who follows up fast. Comment LEAK and we'll check how fast yours replies. Because
